title: Thunderbird suddenly became slow and unstable
creator: VikingBrown
content:
Thunderbird suddenly became slow and unstable.

So I made a settings export and reinstalled.

Hereafter Thunderbird is still unstable and refuses to connect to non gmail servers, settings the same.

Imported non gmail accounts doesn't have folders etc.

What is going on here,?
